metadata.primary_result: 4JDI moves from legacy-atom-name near-miss to review-only peptide-positive evidence: PAK4/Paktide S has source-mapped peptide Ser0 OG 5.862 Angstrom from legacy ANP PB. It is near the 6 Angstrom boundary and not folded-protein evidence.

citation.title: Identification of a major determinant for serine-threonine kinase phosphoacceptor specificity.

gamma_transfer_geometry.gamma_atom_naming_note: Legacy ANP atom naming has PA/PB and no PG; PB is treated as source-declared AMP-PNP terminal gamma-equivalent atom for this review-only artifact.

source_mapped_acceptor.mapping_basis: RCSB title identifies PAK4 in complex with Paktide S peptide substrate; mmCIF maps the modeled peptide Ser auth_seq_id 0 on chain B as the nearest phosphoacceptor.

rows.title: Crystal structure of Serine/threonine-protein kinase PAK 4 in complex with Paktide S peptide substrate
